scope: Independent immutable source, mathematical contract, test oracle, local acceptance and historical-state review; no independent test rerun or protected scientific evidence access.

finding_review.near_tie_failure: Distinct finite binary64 logits separated by 2**-60 can produce exactly equal rounded softmax probabilities. Selecting argmax on validated logits preserves the represented winner; selected-class probability remains the confidence. The old 0.5 accuracy witness is retained.
finding_review.aggregation: NLL, multiclass Brier, accuracy and confidence are explicitly sample-weighted; fixed-bin ECE is descriptive. Log-probability overflow and invalid/broadcast labels reject before aggregate publication.
finding_review.scope_limits: The wrapper restores module modes and uses explicit loader/current forward keywords; it does not promise arbitrary model/loader buffer or RNG rollback. Current real-model preservation is independently asserted in three generated-input integration cases.
finding_review.oracles: Hand-computable and NumPy references, partition invariance, extreme values, exact probability-tie witness, invalid-input transaction checks and actual-model direct-loss comparisons remain present.
finding_review.full_model_claim: No completed full-model scientific implementation, architecture efficacy, calibration guarantee, or scientific gate advancement is established by this unit acceptance.

prior_failed_attempts_retained: Old scorer produces 0.5 accuracy on the exact two-row near-tie witness.
